Cookie Policy

Cookie Policy of Nooney & Dowdall LLP Solicitors

This Cookie Policy outlines the handling of personal data by Nooney & Dowdall LLP Solicitors.

Website: www.mullingarsolicitors.ie.

At Nooney & Dowdall LLP Solicitors, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency in how we use cookies and similar technologies on our website. This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, and your choices regarding their use.

1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, smartphone, or tablet) when you visit a website. They help improve your browsing experience, remember preferences, and provide analytics about site usage.

2. Types of Cookies We Use

We use the following types of cookies on our website:

Essential Cookies:

Necessary for the proper functioning of the website, such as enabling navigation and access to secure areas.

Analytical Cookies:

Help us understand how visitors use our website by collecting information such as page views and traffic sources.

Functional Cookies:

Enhance user experience by remembering preferences, such as language settings.

Marketing Cookies:

Used by third parties to deliver relevant advertisements based on your browsing activity.

3. Third-Party Cookies

Some cookies may be placed by third-party service providers, such as Google Analytics, to help us analyse website performance. These third parties have their own privacy policies governing their use of cookies.

4. Managing Your Cookie Preferences

You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to:

– Block or delete cookies

– Receive notifications before a cookie is stored

– Disable specific types of cookies

Please note that disabling essential cookies may impact the functionality of our website.

5. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology, legal requirements, or our website’s operations. Any updates will be posted on this page with the revised date.

6. Contact Us

If you have any questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at:
